# yodaStruct

> yodaStruct is the Lua and Fennel library for d-SEAMS: `require("dseams")` from Lua 5.4 or LuaJIT, `(require :dseams)` from Fennel, with CHILL and CHILL+ ice labels, Steinhardt order parameters, primitive rings, cages, RDFs, hydrogen bonds and topological fingerprints of molecular simulation frames, through the libseams C API.

The LuaRocks package is `dseams`; `require("yoda")` is the same table. The C module `dseams_core` is built from `src/dseams.c` against `seams.h`, by meson (with seams-core as a wrap subproject) or by LuaRocks (against an installed libseams). The version is the seams-core release it binds. Each link below is a page of https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/. Contributor instructions are in the contributing guide at the repository root.

## Getting started

- [dseams](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/index.html): What the library is and how it relates to seams-core and pydseams.
- [Quickstart](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/quickstart.html): Build with meson, run one example, install the rock, call it from Fennel.

## Tutorials

- [Lua and Fennel tutorial](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/tutorials/lua.html): Every call on the shipped frames, with what each prints, and the LuaJIT FFI.

## How-to guides

- [Install the library](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/howto/install.html): meson, LuaRocks and Nix layouts of `dseams_core.so` and how `require` finds them.
- [Lua and Fennel](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/howto/lua.html): The examples, the Fennel module and the check against the C++ path.
- [Upgrade to 2.14](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/howto/upgrade-2.14.html): Move a 2.10 script off the retired sol2 module.

## Reference

- [Lua API](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/api/lua.html): Every `require("dseams")` call, the `seams.h` function it forwards to, handles, errors and the rock.
- [Lua task](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/lang/task-lua.html): The ice Ih census every d-SEAMS language front prints, in Lua.

## Explanation

- [Three products](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/explanation/frontends.html): `require("dseams")`, `pydseams` and the `seams` CLI.
- [How to cite](https://d-seams.github.io/yodaStruct/explanation/citation.html): The JCIM paper and `CITATION.cff`.

## Engine

- [d-SEAMS/seams-core](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/seams-core): The C++ engine, the libseams C API and the `seams` CLI.
- [seams.h](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/seams-core/blob/main/include/seams.h): The C API header `src/dseams.c` and the FFI cdef are built from.
- [docs.dseams.info](https://docs.dseams.info): d-SEAMS documentation: analyses, C API reference and every language front.

## Other language fronts

- [PydSEAMSlib](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/PydSEAMSlib): Python (`import pydseams`).
- [dseams-rs](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs): Rust crates `dseams-sys` and `dseams`.
- [Dseams.jl](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl): Julia.
- [dseams-r](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-r): R.
- [dseams-fortran](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-fortran): Fortran.

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/yodaStruct/blob/main/README.md): Build, test, the rock, Nix, development against seams-core and the release order.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/yodaStruct/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Released changes; unreleased fragments are in `changelog.d/`.
